name: ANKITA RAINA
bio:
Career Overview: Ankita Raina is a prominent Indian tennis player, recognized as one of the country's top female talents in both singles and doubles.

Playing Style: Known for her aggressive baseline game, solid footwork, and versatility, Raina excels on hard courts and adapts well to various surfaces with a strong two-handed backhand.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #160 (March 2, 2020)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #93 (May 17, 2021)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the second round of qualifying at Wimbledon and the US Open in 2019.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 1 WTA Tour doubles title (2021 Phillip Island Trophy with Kamilla Rakhimova) and 1 WTA 125K doubles title.
  • Secured 11 ITF singles titles and 25 ITF doubles titles.
  • Earned a bronze medal in singles at the 2018 Asian Games and gold medals in singles and mixed doubles at the 2016 South Asian Games.
  • Biggest Singles Win: Defeated former US Open champion Samantha Stosur at the 2019 Kunming Open.

Billie Jean King Cup: Represents India with a win-loss record of 33â€“29, contributing significantly to India's first Fed Cup playoff appearance in 2020.

Other Highlights:
  • Became the fifth Indian woman to break into the WTA top 200 singles rankings in April 2018 and the third to reach the top 100 in doubles in 2021.
  • Trains at the Hemant Bendrey Tennis Academy in Pune and is coached by Arjun Kadhe.

Ankita continues to inspire as a trailblazer in Indian women's tennis with her resilience and dedication.
